metadata.description: Postemi (postemi.com) plugins: the MCP connector for chat, and the CLI for coding agents.

plugins.name: postemi
plugins.description: Social media scheduler for Claude: write, schedule and publish posts to 25+ platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest and Mastodon, with a content calendar and photo and video uploads in full quality. Browser sign-in, no key.

plugins.name: postemi-cli
plugins.description: Postemi CLI for coding agents: the postemi command line tool and its full reference, for scheduling and publishing social posts from a terminal, a script or an agent with a shell (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes).
